_meta.schema: environment/manifest.json (same fields; adds shadow, shadow_blend, pivot_px, pet_walkable_cells, use_points[].actor/anim/z_px/pet_offset_y_px, states)
_meta.style_sheet: art-direction/style-sheet.md v1.4 + "Migi (the user's cat)" AD direction
_meta.screen_of_world: sx = X0 + (c - r) * 32 ; sy = Y0 + (c + r) * 16 - z   (px at 1x; z up in px)
_meta.anchor_rule: image top-left = P(c, r) - anchor, where (c, r) = min corner (north vertex) of the footprint. Wall items: R -> P(c0, 0), L -> P(0, r0).
_meta.depth_rule: objects: key = c + r + depth_offset.back ; front slice: c + r + depth_offset.front ; avatar: pos.c + pos.r + 0.05 ; draw ascending ; pet (Migi): pos.c + pos.r + 0.05 (same as avatars)

pet_actor.draw_rule: frame top-left = P(pos) - (16, 24) px (+ use_point.pet_offset_y_px); SVG units: x=P.x-8, y=P.y-12, w=h=16

_meta.palette: official hexes only (no new hexes, nothing pending)

assets.anchor_note: anchor = pixel on P(c,r) (north vertex of the footprint), exactly like environment/manifest.json; pivot_px = the tile-centre foot point P(c+0.5, r+0.5) in PNG px.

use_points.note: faces the camera; bowl draws over his chin
